Lupa - AI Powered Petcare
 
Lupa is supporting pet parents with all the challenges they face in raising and living with their furry friends.
 
We have built a state-of-the-art mobile app designed for today's pet parent - featuring an online booking platform for petcare services, a cutting-edge AI Veterinary advisor, and a comprehensive medical record.
 
Our world-leading business software empowers petcare service providers to manage all aspects of their business within one integrated solution, harnessing the power of AI.
